name: @epoch/renderer-runtime
description: Epoch Renderer Runtime hosting surface (W013): abstract, provider-neutral renderer descriptors (kind, capabilities, budgets as typed data), renderer-session binding (descriptor x device-session snapshot), typed invocation envelopes (mount-graph / advance-frame / submit-intent), and boundary capability/budget enforcement — anything not declared is denied with typed errors (the W008 permission pattern applied to renderers). Zero engine imports, zero GPU code, zero UI-framework dependencies; concrete engines are future adapters behind the descriptor contract.
